_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Design Data and Calculations
summary: The Design Data and Calculations DID covers graphs, mathematical curves, analysis, tables, and empirical data that quantitatively reflect equipment design and capabilities so the Government can verify contract compliance.
description_purpose:
This type data consists of graphs, mathematical curves, analysis, tables and empirical data which reflect quantitatively the design and capabilities of the equipment.
The purpose of this type data is to enable the Government to verify that the equipment being furnished and represented by this type data is in accordance with the requirements of the contract.
application_interrelationship:
This data item description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
This DID is applicable whenever calculations are required for evaluation and verification of the design capabilities of equipment.
It is applicable to contracts for acquisition of items via a military specification, prepared in accordance with MIL-STD-961, where it is necessary to specify detailed technical content requirements. It should be used in lieu of DI-MISC-80296 for these types of contracts.
The applicable military specification containing the technical content for the design data and calculations shall be stated in Block 16 of the DD Form 1423, Contract Data Requirements List.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Design Data and Calculations shall be in contractor format.

preparation_instructions.title: General content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Design Data and Calculations shall contain sufficient information to ensure that the contractor has met or exceeded all the requirements of the contract. Data shall include:

children.title: Empirical data required to evaluate the equipment as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Technical content.
preparation_instructions.content: Technical content shall be in accordance with the Appendix entitled "Design Data and Calculations Technical Content Requirements" contained in the applicable military specification as stated in the DD Form 1423, Contract Data Requirements List.
